mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate cash flows and increasing equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 8.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers a flight to safety and reduces equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect fails to produce a Rank IC above 0.05 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 97.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which signals weakening economic momentum and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in fewer than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 1-year rolling window is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 2.0% within a 3-month window signals aggressive monetary tightening, which raises discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 8.0% and a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 133,000 signals a labor market breakdown, which reduces consumer confidence and corporate hiring expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 60% of instances where both conditions are met, or the interaction effect fails to achieve a Rank IC above 0.05 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, which triggers expectations of tighter monetary policy and higher real interest rates, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 97.0 combined with a decline in GDP (GDPC1) below 13,500 billion in the prior quarter signals a contraction in real economic output, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 50% of instances where both conditions are met, or the interaction effect fails to produce a Rank IC above 0.05 in any 3-year window.
